input.command:
source /root/.env && curl -s -H "X-N8N-API-KEY: $N8N_API_KEY" "https://xprime17.app.n8n.cloud/api/v1/executions?workflowId=WhT7U8wVOJ9HKDID&limit=10" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
data=json.load(sys.stdin)
for e in data.get('data',[]):
    status = e.get('status','?')
    finished = e.get('stoppedAt','?')
    started = e.get('startedAt','?')
    eid = e.get('id','?')
    print(f'  {eid} | {status} | started={started} | stopped={finished}')
if not data.get('data'):
    print('  No executions found')
"

questions.question: The workflow 'PAI - Email to Jarvis Issue' is inactive. Last execution failed due to Anthropic API rate limit (concurrent connections exceeded) on a blank email (no subject, no sender). How would you like to fix this?

options.label: Reactivate + add retry (Recommended)
options.description: Reactivate the workflow, add a retry mechanism on the AI classification node, and filter out blank/empty emails before classification

options.label: Just reactivate it
options.description: Simply turn it back on — the rate limit was likely transient from a heavy Claude Code session

options.label: Reactivate + switch to cheaper model
options.description: Reactivate and switch from Claude Haiku to a cheaper/faster model (e.g., GPT-4o-mini) to avoid Anthropic rate limit conflicts

options.label: Investigate further first
options.description: Let me look at the successful executions and the Gmail trigger config before making changes

input.command:
source /root/.env && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import json

with open('/tmp/email-workflow-update.json') as f:
    payload = json.load(f)

# Remove problematic settings fields
allowed_settings = {'executionOrder', 'errorWorkflow'}
payload['settings'] = {k: v for k, v in payload['settings'].items() if k in allowed_settings}

# Remove staticData (not needed for update)
if 'staticData' in payload:
    del payload['staticData']

with open('/tmp/email-workflow-update2.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(payload, f)
print("Cleaned payload written")
PYEOF
input.description: Clean payload, remove extra settings fields
